descriptionChirho: The proper name Tamar, referring to Judah's daughter-in-law (Gen 38), Absalom's sister (2 Sam 13), Absalom's daughter (2 Sam 14:27), or a place name marking Judah's southeastern boundary (Ezek 47-48). All 25 occurrences denote the same name. S145404 covers standalone, conjunctive, and lamed-prefixed forms (eng 'Tamar/to Tamar', spa 'Tamar/a Tamar', arb 'ثامارُ/ثامارَ', kor '다말', swa 'Tamari/na Tamari', hin 'तामार'). S145407 has the min preposition (eng 'from Tamar', spa 'desde Tamar', arb 'مِنْ تَامَارَ', kor '에서 다말', swa 'kutoka Tamari'). The split is purely grammatical — different prepositional prefixes — not a different referent or meaning.
